title: File Browser
desc: Host FileBrowser Quantum to manage, preview and share files in the browser
empty: No instances yet. Add one and choose the directories to share to manage files in the browser
adminPasswordHelp: At least 8 characters. Synced to File Browser on every start, so the value here wins; other users are managed in File Browser
confirmDelete: Delete this instance? Its users, share links and other data are deleted too; files in the shared directories are not affected
binaryPlaceholder: Leave empty to search automatically (config directory bin or PATH)
binaryHelp: When empty, the program installed online to {path} below is used first, then the one in PATH
listenPlaceholder: Leave empty to listen on all IPv4 addresses
listenHelp: Use 127.0.0.1 when it is only accessed through a Web Service reverse proxy
baseUrlHelp: When reverse proxying by path in the Web Service (for example /files), enter the same path; keep / for a dedicated domain
sourcesHelp: Each directory appears as a separate source in File Browser; new users can access all directories by default
authNoneWarn: Anyone who can reach this port manages files as the administrator; use it only on a trusted network or behind other authentication
authProxyHelp: Trusts the username header sent by the reverse proxy and creates missing users automatically. Use it with forward auth in the Web Service and keep the File Browser port closed to the outside, otherwise the header can be forged
trustProxyHelp: Turn on behind a reverse proxy to identify the client address and scheme from X-Forwarded-* and X-Real-IP; keep it off when the port is exposed directly
webdavHelp: The WebDAV interface built into File Browser, see the File Browser documentation; turn it off if you do not need it
localeHelp: Interface language for new users; users can change it in File Browser
